title: Quality Assurance
description:
Quality Assurance Architect & Manager
General Description
The Quality Assurance (QA) Architect & Manager oversees the full QA lifecycle for Atlanta Information Management’s (AIM) enterprise applications, ensuring that all software and infrastructure projects meet organizational requirements, function reliably, and provide a high-quality user experience. This role leads testing strategy, QA team performance, and the development of scalable quality frameworks. Responsibilities include defining testing standards, architecting automation strategies, and ensuring alignment with organizational and end-user expectations across all of AIM’s initiatives.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Quality Leadership & Strategy
· Provide management of the full QA lifecycle, ensuring consistent quality across proprietary and enterprise systems.
· Lead and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles to ensure solutions meet business expectations and improve employee processes.
· Documentation services including Test Plans, Regression Testing, and Smoke Testing.
· Facilitate all testing phases and ensure results are documented and tracked accurately.
· Certify the functionality, reliability, accessibility, and performance of production applications.
· Automate regression tests using repeatable, scalable scripts.
· Ensure all projects meet client team expectations and align with requirements.
· Perform verification activities on web-based proprietary software to ensure ongoing product quality.
· Assign, schedule, and oversee daily activities of QA team members.
· Delegate appropriately based on skill sets and responsibilities.
· Promote and foster an environment that proactively supports change, innovation, and continuous improvement.
· Review and analyze team workload before making assignments and project decisions.
· Infuse a learning culture and drive continual improvement within the QA team.
· Hold staff accountable with clear direction and measurable objectives.
· Engage employees in ongoing performance conversations.
· Empower team members to meet project objectives and customer expectations.
· Coordinate with AIM Management and HR on personnel matters such as development, performance, and discipline.
· Develop training programs for all QA positions to support skill growth and cross-training.
Cross-Department Collaboration & Governance
· Manage enterprise application projects and priorities in collaboration with other division managers.
· Review and develop cross-divisional project schedules.
· Develop and maintain processes, procedures, and policies as appropriate.
· Recommend strategic technology or business system changes to the CIO and leadership teams.
· Contribute to short- and long-term strategic planning for the IT Department.
· Manage and administer service level agreements (SLAs) with business clients.
· Share responsibility for major IT governance processes such as Change Management, Release Management, and Request Management.
· Establish and enforce technical standards related to database, server, desktop, development, and other environments.
· Ensure customer service experience and communication with stakeholders remain a top priority.
· Recommend and manage assigned budgets, including capital project budgets.
· Monitor performance to ensure city funds are managed responsibly and transparently.
· Oversee and strengthen relationships between the Enterprise Applications Team and business stakeholders.
· Lead the selection, design, integration, and operation of enterprise applications and business software solutions across the city.
Additional Leadership & Architecture Responsibilities
· Define QA architectural standards and frameworks, including test data management, test environment management, and automation architecture.
· Evaluate and implement modern QA tools, technologies, and platforms to increase efficiency and automation maturity.
· Establish KPIs, dashboards, and quality metrics to monitor product quality, team performance, and release readiness.
· Conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) for defects and production issues, ensuring long-term corrective actions.
· Ensure compliance with security, accessibility/ADA, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
This is a partial list of the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities for the role:
· Ability to consistently meet deadlines and manage competing priorities.
· Experience working on software development teams and within modern SDLC frameworks.
· Excellent soft skills, including communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution.
· Familiarity with ERP processes and enterprise application ecosystems.
· Programming skills sufficient for creating automated tests in various languages.
· Knowledge of Agile Testing principles and the full SDLC framework.
· Cross-browser and cross-platform testing experience.
· Experience with tools such as SOAP-UI, TestIM, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, BrowserStack, Percy, and related platforms.
· Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how automated testing integrates with DevOps workflows.
· Ability to mentor QA engineers and interns, develop technical career paths, and conduct skills assessments.
· Strong analytical and architectural thinking skills, especially in evaluating risk, complexity, and scalability
Minimum Qualifications – Education & Experience
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience in Information Technology, Business, Public Administration, or related field.
· 5 years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise applications, including at least 2 years in Project Management or equivalent leadership roles.
· Proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, MS Visio, and MS SharePoint.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills.
· Understanding of QA methodologies, lifecycle, and processes.
· Experience with Software Engineering, Information Systems, or relevant technical disciplines.
· Strong knowledge of application development methodologies and implementation.
· Experience managing the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
· Experience leading or architecting QA automation frameworks at enterprise scale.
Nice to Haves
· Project Management Professional (PMP)
· Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
· Business Analytics Certification
· Full-Stack Development Certification
· Certification in DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Automation Tools

Role Overview
We are seeking experienced ATE Test Development Engineers to support mixed-signal IC validation and production test development initiatives. This role will focus on advanced ATE solutions using the Cohu DxV platform, with contributions across multiple programs.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in mixed-signal semiconductor testing, deep hands-on experience with Cohu DxV, and the ability to operate across both modern and legacy test systems.

• Develop, debug, and optimize ATE test programs for mixed-signal ICs
• Lead test development on Cohu DxV platform (primary “workhorse” ATE system)
• Support validation and production test
• Collaborate with design, validation, and product engineering teams to ensure test coverage and quality
• Perform characterization, correlation, and yield improvement activities
• Support test migration and coexistence between legacy and modern ATE systems
• Develop documentation for test methods, hardware interfaces, and program flows

Required Technical Skills
ATE Platform Expertise (Critical)
• Strong hands-on experience with Cohu DxV (required)
• Familiarity with multi-site, high-throughput test architectures

o Test program development and debugging
o Device interface board (DIB) bring-up and validation
o Instrument control (analog/digital resources)
o Test time optimization and parallelism strategies
Expanded: Cohu DxV Experience Expectations
Candidates must demonstrate deep functional and operational knowledge of the Cohu DxV platform, including:
• Test Program Development:
o Writing and optimizing DxV test programs using native development environments
o Implementing complex test flows for mixed-signal devices
o Debugging test failures and improving coverage
• Mixed-Signal Instrumentation Use:
o Configuring and using analog and digital instrument resources
o Handling precision measurements (Client/DAC validation, voltage/current accuracy)
o Synchronizing digital pattern generation with analog measurements
• Hardware Integration:
o Working with Device Interface Boards (DIBs) and probe/load boards
o Debugging signal integrity and hardware/software interactions
• Production Readiness:
o Optimizing test time and multi-site efficiency
o Supporting yield ramp and production qualification
o Performing correlation between bench, validation systems, and ATE
• Debug & Optimization:
o Root cause analysis of test failures (hardware vs software vs design)
o Improving test robustness and repeatability

IC & Domain Expertise
• Experience with 16-bit to 32-bit IC architectures
• Strong understanding of mixed-signal systems (Analog + Digital)
• Familiarity with:
o ARM Cortex-M0 or similar embedded processors
o Sensor-integrated ICs (accelerometers, sensing elements)
o Signal acquisition and conditioning circuits
Functional Test Knowledge
• Testing and validation of:
o Pacing engines
o Signal sensing circuits
o Accelerometer-based systems

Additional / Preferred Skills
• Experience with Credence D10 (legacy ATE systems)
• Ability to work across multiple test platforms and legacy environments
• Background in medical devices or implantable electronics (strong plus)
• Experience with test method migration from legacy to modern ATE systems
________________________________________
Ideal Candidate Profile
• 4+ years of experience in ATE test development (mixed-signal focus)
• Proven expertise in Cohu DxV platform (must-have)
• Strong problem-solving skills in test/debug/production environments
• Ability to adapt to complex, multi-program semiconductor projects

25% Hardware–Software Integration & Debugging

● Continuously improve bring-up workflows, tooling, and automation where applicable

● Ability to mentor engineers and establish best practices for bring-up and debugging

● Hands-on experience with Qualcomm automotive SoCs (e.g., SA8155P, SA8255P, or similar)
● Experience developing and debugging kernel drivers and/or HAL layers (C/C++)
● Board bring-up experience including bootloaders, device trees, and low-level initialization
● Deep understanding of interrupts, DMA, memory mapping, clocks/resets, and power management
● Strong hardware debug skills using logs, tracing, and lab tools (e.g., JTAG)
Optional Skills
● Master’s degree in a related technical field
● Experience in automotive IVI / digital cockpit systems
● Experience with multimedia subsystems (audio, display, camera) and/or connectivity (USB, Ethernet, BT/Wi‐Fi)
● Experience supporting DV, PV, and EOL / manufacturing phases
● Familiarity with NXP S32K microcontrollers and cross-ECU power coordination
● Experience with FreeRTOS or microcontrollers
● Safety awareness: familiarity with ISO 26262 concepts

title: GA DDS IT Support Specialist 3
description:
Short Description:
Under direct supervision, provides management information system user support on a continuing basis either by phone or site visit. Troubleshoots end-user problems.

Complete Description:
*Must Be Local to Metro Atlanta*
**Professional certification (e.g., A+, Network+, Cloud+ or equivalent) MUST UPLOAD CERTIFICATION***


Duties and Responsibilities:


This position is looking for an IT Support Specialist
3 who will maintain business applications and critical infrastructure and
provide management and support for additional DDS systems (e.g., Nemo Q/GALA,
VRT cameras, A/V, mobile systems).
Experience providing operations support to triage production incidents
and engage with respective partners to restore services and post incident
review to prevent future occurrences.
This position will require an individual who is willing to continuously
learn and remain current and knowledgeable about emerging IT technologies

Specific Duties Include:
•Maintaining cost-efficient, scalable cloud environments for the organization.
•Understanding business objectives of the company and creating cloud-based solutions to facilitate those objectives.
•Designing, building, and maintaining internal cloud applications for the organization.
•Keeping up to date on best practices in cloud computing and making improvements to the cloud infrastructure of their company or organization.
•Making hardware and software recommendations for the organization, based on needs of the project and organization.
•Experience in automation and provisioning technologies, such as AWS CLI and Terraform.
•Monitors Service Now ticket queue, responds to tickets in a timely manner and provides follow-up with end users.
•Provides customer support in supporting software, configurations, and business submission processes.
•Looking for ways to improve operations within company to digitize common tasks.
•Keeping data leakage and downtime to an absolute minimum.
•Assists other members of the IT Infrastructure team.
•Monitors ticket activities and provide escalation when needed.
•Troubleshoot and support PC, laptop (Win 10/11), scanners and local and network printers, google print, chrome boxes and other field system support.
•May act as an administrator or agency subject matter expert for lobby management software or other DDS applications as needed.
Minimum
Qualifications:


Bachelor's
degree from an accredited college or university in a related field such as
computer and information technology, computer science, software engineering AND
three years of related experience.


OR



Associate's/Vocational/Technical
degree in a related field such as computer and information technology, computer
science, software engineering from an accredited college or university AND five
years of related experience.


OR


One
year of experience at the lower-level IT Support Specialist 2 or position
equivalent.
Competencies Needed
•2-3+ years providing IT support and management experience
•Professional certification (e.g. A+, Network+, Cloud+ or equivalent)
•Experience with using ServiceNow.
•Ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language.
•Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential. Must be a result and goal-oriented individual with the persistence and patience necessary to work effectively with a variety of internal and external constituencies.
•Must have the ability to detect emerging trends and make recommendations for change.
•Experience with installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of desktop computer hardware, operating systems, and application software in a multi-computer environment.
•Display current knowledge of technologies (computer systems, mobile devices, and technology products).
